user.title: Add a device
user.description: The switch wakes this device and shows whether it is currently awake.

data_description.mac: MAC address of the device to wake up.
data_description.host: IP address used to check whether the device is awake.
data_description.method: Use ICMP ping for PCs. Macs answer ping while asleep, so use a TCP probe for those.
data_description.port: Only used by the TCP probe, ignored by ping. Any port works: an open port and a refused connection both prove the machine is awake. 54321 is a safe default.
data_description.broadcast_address: Leave empty and it is derived from the IP address above (192.168.0.105 -> 192.168.0.255). The magic packet always goes to 255.255.255.255 as well, so both kinds of broadcast are covered.
data_description.broadcast_port: The port to send the magic packet to. Defaults to 9 and is normally not changed.

error.invalid_mac: That is not a valid MAC address.
error.port_required: The TCP probe needs a port number.

abort.already_configured: This MAC address is already set up.
